'''Vladlun Travan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] criminal who resided on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|All of the original kidnappers are now dead, except for two. Those last two have evaded me and now my age and dwindling wealth have forced me to turn to someone else for assistance.|[[Wernell Covington]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:V" />}}
Sometime during the last decade of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]],<ref name="TQC">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68410&month=082009|text=Friday Feature &ndash; The Quest Continues}}</ref> Vladlun Travan planned and organized a criminal plot to kidnap [[Felicia]], the daughter of the wealthy land owner [[Wernell Covington]]. Although Covington accepted to pay the ransom, things turned bad and Felicia was killed by the kidnappers. The poor girl was jettisoned into space from the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on which she was being held. Vladlun Travan was identified by the authorities at that moment but he managed to flee and escape justice for many years.<ref name="SWG:V" />

Almost three decades later,<ref name="TQC" /> by the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Vladlun Travan was living on Rori where he was leading his own [[Vladlun's gang|gang]].<ref name="SWG:V" /> Three of his associates were [[Titus Dabrini]], [[Aztin Maru]] and [[Tiaba Charr]].<ref name="SWG:BFTYTtW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Boba Fett Throws You To the Wolves|Rori}}</ref> However, Wernell Covington was still looking for the escaped murderers of his beloved daughter. In fact, two members of the group that kidnapped Felicia were still free: Vladlun Travan and [[Jurgen Nath]].<ref name="SWG:V" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Wernell Covington hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to investigate the whereabouts of the remaining kidnappers. With the help of [[Horace Korr]], a retired [[Corellia Times]] [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]], the spacer was able to identify the two remaining murderers. An associate of Covington in the [[Narmle Militia]] was later able to provide the last known locations of the criminals. After having killed Jurgen Nath, the spacer tracked Vladlun Travan to his [[Vladlun Travan's Hideout|hideout]] and fought Vladlun's gang. The spacer finally found Vladlun Travan and killed him for his involvement in the kidnapping and death of the young Felicia.<ref name="SWG:V" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vladlun Travan was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:V" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Vladlun Travan was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 12|Game Update 12]]," on [[August 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 12: Engineering Trader">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=976424|text=Game Update 12: Engineering Trader}}</ref>
